name: Jimmy Eagle Jr, SHRM-CP
headline: Talent Acquisition Specialist at Crisis Prevention Institute

experiences.description:
- Responded to associate questions, concerns, and feedback on HR policies and procedures.
- Facilitated orientation and training to newly hired associates.
- Audited and developed pre-employment processes, including background and drug screenings.
- Assisted HR Directors on investigations, information gathering, problem solving, and special projects.

- Instructed orientations and on-boarded newly hired employees.
- Recruited talent from local colleges and career fairs.
- Administered Workers Comp, Cobra, and FMLA materials as needed.
- Interviewed and hired the top candidates to fill the needs and culture of the business.

-Managed and led team members on managerial shifts.
-Resolved customer issues that occurred.
-Performed daily and nightly opening and closing procedures.
-Directed associates with tasks and projects.

-Provided superior customer service to shoppers.
-Assisted visual team in developing store displays and visuals.
-Properly handled cash and drawer on a daily bases.
-Stocked and replenished merchandise regularly.
